title: K Divisible Elements Subarrays
description:
Given `nums`, `k`, and `p`, count the distinct nonempty contiguous subarrays containing at most `k` elements divisible by `p`. Subarrays are equal only when their lengths and every corresponding value are equal.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [2,3,3,2,2], k = 2, p = 2
Output: 11
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4], k = 4, p = 1
Output: 10
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 200`
- `1 <= nums[i], p <= 200`
- `1 <= k <= nums.length`
